tools.name: load_toolset
tools.title: Load a toolset
tools.description: Enable an additional group of fabdesk tools for this session. Toolsets: project (read/write project files, sketches, board settings, adopt a KiCad board), circuit (query the board, search footprint libraries), route (routing status/cancel/unroute/scope), kicad (board stats), verify (ERC, release gate), render (schematic/PCB SVG, 3D GLB), export (gerbers, drill, pick-and-place, BOM, netlist, zip), sim (SPICE netlist and simulation), app (screenshot and drive the fabPlane desktop app window on the user's behalf: find/click/type, switch project, tab, thread, send chat messages, control Route Cinema; needs the app running in dev or with FABDESK_AUTOMATION=1 — not for diagnosing a route: route_status and reports/drc.json say more than a screenshot). Call this before using a tool from that group; the core tools (project_status, circuit_build, circuit_place, circuit_read_errors, route_run, verify_drc, render_board) are always available.

tools.name: project_status
tools.title: Project status
tools.description: Summarise the current project: id, directory, board settings, which artefacts exist (circuit.netlist.json, board.kicad_pcb, board.kicad_sch), last build error count, latest route run and available reports. Call it first to learn the file contract before writing circuit.netlist.json.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: circuit_build
tools.title: Build the board
tools.description: Compile circuit.netlist.json into board.kicad_pcb and a generated board.kicad_sch. Footprints are pulled from KiCad libraries, explicitly placed when board.placements names them, and connected into the ratsnest; libSource draws searchable schematic symbols with labelled wire stubs. Returns actionable errors/warnings. Rebuilds replace only generated schematic items, preserve manual schematic work and unlisted manual footprint placement, keep tracks whose nets still exist, and remove footprints the netlist no longer names.

entrypoint.description: Netlist file relative to the project, default circuit.netlist.json

rebuild.description: preserve keeps compatible existing copper; clean removes routed tracks/arcs/vias after source validation before rebuilding

fresh.description: Discard the existing board first (outline, placement, tracks) and build from the netlist alone. Needed after changing the board size: a build never redraws an outline that exists.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: circuit_place
tools.title: Place footprints
tools.description: Move footprints on the built board: each entry is a reference with its new origin in mm in KiCad board coordinates (y downwards; the outline's corner is NOT at 0,0 — read it with circuit_query select=outline first) and an optional rotation in degrees. Use it when the autoplacer left parts off the board or in a corner (DRC copper_edge_clearance / courtyards_overlap), or to put connectors on an edge before route_run. Tracks are not moved: unroute affected nets and route again afterwards. Rebuilding keeps placements.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: circuit_read_errors
tools.title: Read build errors
tools.description: Return the errors and warnings of the last circuit_build (from reports/build.json). Use it to decide what to fix in circuit.netlist.json.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: route_run
tools.title: Autoroute the board
tools.description: Autoroute board.kicad_pcb on the design server (capacity: the built-in JS router; freerouting: internal builds only). Streams progress frames to the app, persists them under .fabdesk/runs/<runId>/frames.jsonl, applies the tracks to the board as one undo entry and returns which nets stayed open plus via/track counts. Requires circuit_build. Use route_unroute + route_run with onlyConnections to redo specific nets. If routing reports a blocked endpoint or board-edge violation, move the named footprint inward or enlarge the board, rebuild, and retry; never split or rename an electrical net merely to bypass a routing failure.

router.description: Router; defaults to the project's fabdesk.json router

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: verify_drc
tools.title: Run KiCad DRC
tools.description: Run KiCad design rule check on board.kicad_pcb. Writes reports/drc.json and returns error/warning/unconnected counts with the first violations. Requires kicad-cli and circuit_build.

severity.description: Report all severities or errors only

schematicParity.description: Also check PCB↔schematic parity (requires libSource for generated symbols)

limit.description: Max violations to include in the text summary

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: render_board
tools.title: Render board image
tools.description: Render a PNG of the KiCad board (top or bottom, raytraced optional) to renders/<view>.png and return it as an image so you can inspect placement and routing. Requires kicad-cli and circuit_build.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: project_read_file
tools.title: Read a project file
tools.description: Read a text file inside the project directory (e.g. circuit.netlist.json, reports/drc.json, fabdesk.json). Paths are relative to the project and may not leave it. Binary files are reported by size only; use project_list_sketches for images.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: project_write_file
tools.title: Write a project file
tools.description: Create or overwrite a text file inside the project directory, creating parent directories. Use it to write circuit.netlist.json. Paths are relative to the project and may not leave it; fabdesk.json must be changed through project_set_board.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: project_list_sketches
tools.title: List sketches
tools.description: List the user's sketch images (PNG/JPEG/SVG under sketches/) with absolute paths so you can open them with your image reading capability. Sketches describe the desired board; interpret them before writing circuit.netlist.json.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: project_set_board
tools.title: Set board settings
tools.description: Update board constraints in fabdesk.json: layer count (1-8), outline width/height in mm, the router to use, and optionally a prefab blank template. The size becomes the board outline the next circuit_build draws (when circuit.netlist.json has no board of its own); board.rules reach the KiCad board on the next build; the router is used by route_run. template="viagrid-9055" sets up Opulo's 90 x 55 mm Viagrid blank: circuit_build then draws the blank itself (outline, 180 factory vias as free vias, 4 mounting holes, 0.2 mm track and clearance rules) instead of the netlist's board, and route_run uses the laser-prefab solver so layers change only through the factory vias, which it claims. template="none" removes it.

template.description: Prefab blank to design on; viagrid-9055 or none

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: project_import_kicad
tools.title: Adopt a KiCad board
tools.description: Copy an existing .kicad_pcb (and its .kicad_pro / .kicad_sch when they sit next to it) into the project as board.kicad_pcb, board.kicad_pro and board.kicad_sch, so route_run, verify_drc, render and export tools work on it. The board becomes the design; a later circuit_build updates it from circuit.netlist.json (footprints the netlist does not name are removed). Sets fabdesk.json board.layers from the board when kicad-cli is available.

path.description: Absolute path to the .kicad_pcb, or a path relative to the project

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: circuit_query
tools.title: Query the board
tools.description: List what the board holds, straight from KiCad, as a compact table: components (ref, value, footprint, position), nets (name, pad count), pads (component, number, net, position, size), vias (position, net; a blank's free vias have an empty net), tracks (routed tracks/arcs/vias per net), unrouted (the airlines still open) or outline (the Edge.Cuts bounding box in mm — read it before circuit_place: the outline's corner is not at 0,0). Optional substring filter on names. Requires circuit_build.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: circuit_search_parts
tools.title: Search KiCad libraries
tools.description: Search the KiCad footprint or symbol libraries the design server can see. Footprint results go in component `footprint`; symbol results split at the colon into `libSource: {lib, part}` so circuit_build can draw the generated schematic.

tools.name: circuit_describe_part
tools.title: Describe a KiCad part
tools.description: Inspect one exact KiCad symbol or footprint before wiring or placing it. Symbols return pin numbers, names and electrical types; footprints return pad numbers, anchor-relative positions and sizes in millimetres.

tools.name: route_status
tools.title: Routing status
tools.description: Status of a route run (default: the latest for the project): running/done/failed, open nets, statistics and the frames file path.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: route_cancel
tools.title: Cancel routing
tools.description: Cancel the running route job on the design server. The job stops between steps; nothing is applied to the board.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: route_unroute
tools.title: Remove routed tracks
tools.description: Delete routed tracks, arcs and vias from the board — all of them or only the named nets — so they can be rerouted with route_run {onlyConnections}. One undo entry in KiCad.

connections.description: Net names to unroute; omit for all

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: route_scope
tools.title: Nets attached to components
tools.description: List the nets attached to component references (e.g. the footprints a repair touches) so they can be unrouted and re-routed with route_run {onlyConnections}. Nets that own a copper pour are excluded by default and listed with the reason.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: kicad_stats
tools.title: Board statistics
tools.description: Board statistics from KiCad: outline size, layer count, footprint/pad/track/via counts, drill sizes. Requires kicad-cli and board.kicad_pcb.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: verify_erc
tools.title: Run KiCad ERC
tools.description: Run KiCad electrical rule check on board.kicad_sch, write reports/erc.json and return counts plus the first violations. For generated schematics, give every component a valid libSource and review build warnings first.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: verify_gate
tools.title: Release gate
tools.description: Evaluate the release gate over the latest reports/drc.json and reports/erc.json: pass when DRC errors == 0, unconnected == 0, ERC errors == 0 and every DRC warning signature is in fabdesk.json allowedDrcWarnings. Returns the reasons for failure and new warning signatures; pass acceptWarnings=true to baseline the current warnings (only after a human reviewed them).

acceptWarnings.description: Add the current new warning signatures to the allowed baseline

requireErc.description: Fail when no ERC report exists

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: verify_viagrid
tools.title: Check the Viagrid rules
tools.description: For a project on a Viagrid 9055 blank (project_set_board template=viagrid-9055): reads the vias and pads from the KiCad board on the design server and checks that every via is one of the blank's 180 factory vias (claimed by route_run, none added elsewhere or stacked on a factory via), that the whole blank is there, and that pads stay clear of the four mounting holes. Writes reports/viagrid.json. Run it after route_run and before verify_drc; positions in the report are in the blank's frame (centre origin, +y up).

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: render_schematic_svg
tools.title: Render schematic SVG
tools.description: Render board.kicad_sch to renders/schematic.svg with kicad-cli and return it. circuit_build draws components that supply libSource and labelled wire stubs for their connected pins.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: render_pcb_svg
tools.title: Render PCB SVG
tools.description: Render board.kicad_pcb (copper, silkscreen, edge cuts) to renders/pcb.svg with kicad-cli and return it. Requires circuit_build.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: render_glb
tools.title: Export 3D GLB
tools.description: Export a 3D model (GLB) of the KiCad board to renders/board.glb for the app's 3D tab. Requires kicad-cli and board.kicad_pcb.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: export_gerbers
tools.title: Export Gerbers
tools.description: Export Gerber files for all copper, mask, paste, silkscreen and edge layers to exports/gerbers/. Requires kicad-cli and board.kicad_pcb.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: export_drill
tools.title: Export drill files
tools.description: Export Excellon drill files (plated/non-plated, with map) to exports/gerbers/. Requires kicad-cli and board.kicad_pcb.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: export_pos
tools.title: Export pick-and-place
tools.description: Export the component placement (pick-and-place) CSV to exports/positions.csv. Requires kicad-cli and board.kicad_pcb.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: export_bom
tools.title: Export BOM
tools.description: Export the bill of materials CSV (reference, value, footprint, quantity and any extra fields) from circuit.netlist.json to exports/bom.csv.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: export_netlist
tools.title: Export netlist
tools.description: Export the netlist to exports/netlist.<net|cir>: kicadsexpr is the KiCad netlist the last circuit_build handed to KiCad; spice is generated from circuit.netlist.json.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: export_zip
tools.title: Zip fabrication outputs
tools.description: Bundle exports/gerbers, positions.csv and bom.csv into exports/fabrication.zip for upload to a fab house. Run export_gerbers, export_drill, export_pos and export_bom first (missing ones are skipped and reported).

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: export_dxf
tools.title: Export DXF artwork
tools.description: Export one DXF per layer (mm) to exports/dxf/: the copper-removal artwork for prefab blanks such as Viagrid, where a laser (LightBurn) or CNC isolates the traces instead of a fab. Default layers F.Cu, B.Cu and Edge.Cuts. The bottom layer is drawn as seen from the top: mirror it in the laser software before burning. Requires kicad-cli and board.kicad_pcb.

layers.description: KiCad layer names, e.g. F.Cu, B.Cu, Edge.Cuts, F.Mask

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: sim_spice_netlist
tools.title: Generate SPICE netlist
tools.description: Generate a SPICE netlist from circuit.netlist.json (R/C/L by value, V/I sources, diodes with a default model), save it to exports/circuit.cir and return it. ICs without models are omitted with a note.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: sim_run
tools.title: Run SPICE simulation
tools.description: Simulate circuit.netlist.json: analysis op (DC operating point), tran (transient; needs stopS, optional stepS) or ac (needs startHz/stopHz). Engine spicey (bundled, default) or ngspice (needs ngspice installed or KiCad's bundled copy). Writes reports/spice.json and returns a table of node voltages / branch currents (first rows for tran/ac).

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: app_state
tools.title: Desktop app state
tools.description: Inspect the running fabPlane desktop app: version, windows (id, bounds, focus, url) and a snapshot of the renderer UI (active project and thread, board tab, open panels, Route Cinema run/cursor/view mode/perf, auth and core status). Call it first to learn what the app is showing before screenshotting or clicking. Fails with `unavailable` when no app bridge is running.

tools.name: app_screenshot
tools.title: Screenshot the app window
tools.description: Capture the fabPlane desktop window (or a region of it, CSS pixels) and return the image so you can see what the user sees. Defaults: scale 0.5, JPEG for full-window captures, PNG for regions. Use app_find to locate elements and app_click/app_type/app_key to interact, then screenshot again to verify.

windowId.description: Window id from app_state; default focused/first window

region.description: Crop to this rectangle (CSS px, top-left origin of the page)

scale.description: Downscale factor; default 0.5 for full window, 1 for regions

format.description: Image format; default jpeg for full window, png for regions

annotate.description: Reserved: overlay element refs (currently a no-op)

tools.name: app_find
tools.title: Find UI elements
tools.description: Search the app window for interactive or labelled elements (buttons, links, inputs, selects and their options, tabs, anything with a role, aria-label or data-testid) whose role, name, text or testid contains the query (case-insensitive; best matches first). Returns a `ref` per match: a stable CSS selector you pass to app_click {selector} or app_type {selector}. Example: app_find "Route Cinema" → click the tab; app_find "whole board" → pick a select option.

query.description: Text to look for in role, name, text or data-testid

tools.name: app_click
tools.title: Click in the app
tools.description: Click an element by CSS selector (use a `ref` from app_find) or at window coordinates (CSS px). Selector clicks scroll the element into view and send real mouse events at its centre so React handlers fire; clicking an <option> selects it in its <select>. Follow with app_screenshot or app_state to verify.

x.description: CSS px from the left edge of the page (when no selector)

y.description: CSS px from the top edge of the page (when no selector)

tools.name: app_type
tools.title: Type text in the app
tools.description: Type text with real key events into the focused element, or focus `selector` first (a ref from app_find, e.g. the chat textarea). Newlines are typed as Shift+Enter; send Enter with app_key. For the chat composer prefer app_send_message, which sets the text and sends through the UI.

tools.name: app_key
tools.title: Press a key
tools.description: Send one key press (down/up) to the app using Electron accelerator syntax: `Enter`, `Escape`, `Tab`, `CommandOrControl+K` (command palette), `CommandOrControl+,` (settings), `Shift+Enter`, `ArrowDown`. Use it for shortcuts and to submit or dismiss dialogs.

key.description: Accelerator string, e.g. Enter, Escape, CommandOrControl+K

tools.name: app_select_project
tools.title: Select a project in the app
tools.description: Make a project the active one in the desktop UI (sidebar filter, board panel, new chats). Accepts a project id, name or path; resolved through the core's project store first. Returns the resulting UI state.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path

tools.name: app_open_tab
tools.title: Open a board tab
tools.description: Open one of the board panel tabs (schematic, pcb, cinema = Route Cinema, 3d, drc, renders, files) and make sure the board panel is visible.

tools.name: app_open_thread
tools.title: Open a chat thread
tools.description: Show an existing chat thread by id in the desktop UI (as if clicked in the sidebar).

tools.name: app_new_chat
tools.title: Start a new chat
tools.description: Switch the desktop UI to a fresh, unsaved chat (composer focused) in the active project. The thread is created when the first message is sent.

tools.name: app_send_message
tools.title: Send a chat message through the UI
tools.description: Put text in the chat composer and send it exactly as a user would (creating the thread when the UI is on a new chat, starting the selected agent run). Optionally pick the agent first. Returns whether the composer accepted the send and the thread id afterwards; use app_state/app_screenshot to follow the run.

agent.description: Agent id to select in the composer before sending (e.g. claude, codex)

tools.name: app_cinema
tools.title: Control Route Cinema
tools.description: Drive the Route Cinema tab: view (mode = board to fit the whole board, activity to follow recent copper), seek (index = frame to show; leaves live-follow), live (follow the newest frame again), layer (layer = copper layer index to toggle visibility), load (run = id of a persisted route run to replay, e.g. from route_status). The cinema only has a run after route_run streamed one in this app session or after load. Opens the cinema tab first. Returns the cinema state.

tools.name: app_wait_for
tools.title: Wait for a UI condition
tools.description: Poll a JavaScript expression in the renderer until it is truthy or the timeout elapses. The expression sees `state` (the app_state UI snapshot: activeProjectId, activeThreadId, boardTab, cinema.frames, ...) and `document`. Examples: `state.boardTab === 'cinema'`, `state.cinema.frames > 10`, `!!document.querySelector('[data-testid="production-toggle"]')`.

tools.name: app_eval
tools.title: Evaluate JavaScript in the app
tools.description: Run arbitrary JavaScript in the renderer main world (dev/automation builds only) and return its JSON-serialisable result. `window.__fabdeskApp` exposes the automation API (state(), find(), selectProject(), ...). Prefer the specific app_* tools; use this for one-off inspection.

code.description: Expression or statements (use `return` in statement form); async allowed
